name.description: Module name in kebab-case (e.g. 'feedback'). Becomes the directory name and the route path.

dependencies.description: Comma-separated list of module names this module depends on (e.g. 'core,auth').

addRoute.description: Inject the module's routes into the app's main routes file.

routePath.description: Path under which to mount the module. Defaults to the module name.

guarded.description: When true, the scaffolded route includes canActivate: [authGuard].
